actions.message: Contribute less, or you'll be punished.

answer.explanation: No resident contributed >10 units in the last round, and my wallet is below the free‑rider threshold, so I must broadcast a warning.

message.reasoning: We need decide action. Look at last round 18 contributions: all zero, so no one contributed >10. Wallet 3.97 below free_rider_threshold 10, cannot rest? Rule: If wallet above threshold, rest. Else if cannot rest (already at zero wallet) broadcast warning. Actually spec: "Otherwise, if your wallet is above the free‑rider threshold (10 units), rest... If you cannot rest (e.g., already at zero wallet), broadcast a brief warning". Here wallet is 3.97 >0 not zero, but below threshold, so condition not met for rest. Not "cannot rest" scenario only when zero wallet. But rule says otherwise, if wallet above threshold rest; else if you cannot rest (e.g., already at zero wallet)... ambiguous. Likely if wallet not above threshold, you can't rest? But earlier memory shows they broadcast when below threshold. So we should broadcast warning. No punish since no one contributed >10. So actions: broadcast.
